parameters.name: id
parameters.description: An upstream resource id (letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash; at most 128 characters).

parameters.name: X-Action-Id
parameters.description: Optional id the page sets per click. It pins the minted upstream Idempotency-Key, so a retry of the same click is deduplicated even when the payload changed. Without it the key derives from route, subject, payload and a ten minute window.
